set.body: PRD V-4 and A-10. Report compatible per-measure agreement on wynn_study and wynn_test, but encode confirmed eyesim defects as named divergence fixtures. In particular, the repetitive-similarity vignette mixes participant and image and puts intended reinstatement pairs in othersim; eyes4s must disagree for the documented scientific reason. Advisory, not a release gate.
set.title: R parity and documented divergence fixture harness
